similar.name: Protriptyline
problems: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for mental health effects

summary: Maprotiline carries a boxed warning in the United States for mental health or psychiatric harm [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests done on people, found a high risk score for the heart and a low risk score for the liver [M]. A similar medicine called Protriptyline also has a boxed warning in the United States for psychiatric harm [4].
